target_customer: Forward deployed, solutions and implementation engineers and deployment leads who take customers live with software
problem: Deployment teams do customer discovery, scoping and build work by hand; OpenScaffold agents read customer calls, emails and tickets and brief coding agents.
business_model: B2B SaaS with free signup; pricing not stated
product_category: AI agents for software deployment and implementation teams

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents over email, calls and tickets with integrations to many tools is standard LLM engineering; reliable scoping from messy customer data is the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Playbooks carried across deployments could create lock-in, but coding agent vendors and horizontal agent platforms can copy the workflow.

market_need_then: Forward deployed engineering was described as the fastest-growing role at AI startups in 2026, with many open roles at companies like Sierra, which signals deployment labor demand.
